# Subtract blank chromatograms

Subtracts a blank chromatogram from each sample in a `chrom_list`, using
either the mean of all blanks, the nearest blank in run order, or the
most recent preceding blank.

## Usage

``` r
subtract_blanks(
  chrom_list,
  pattern = NULL,
  blank_id,
  method = c("mean", "nearest", "preceding"),
  zero_floor = FALSE
)
```

## Arguments

- chrom_list:

  A `chrom_list` object.

- pattern:

  A regular expression matched against `names(chrom_list)` to identify
  blanks (e.g. `"^Blank"` for samples named `Blank1`, `Blank2`, etc.).
  Takes precedence over `blank_id` if both are supplied.

- blank_id:

  Names or indices of the elements in `chrom_list` that are blanks.
  Ignored if `pattern` is supplied.

- method:

  How to select the blank to subtract for each sample: `"mean"`
  subtracts the elementwise mean of all blanks from every sample;
  `"nearest"` subtracts the blank closest in run order (list position),
  taking the earlier one when two are equally close; `"preceding"`
  subtracts the closest blank occurring before the sample in run order,
  and raises an error if a sample has none.

- zero_floor:

  Logical. If `TRUE`, values below zero after subtraction are set to
  zero, with a warning if this affects more than 5% of a sample's
  values. Defaults to `FALSE`: a blank that matches the samples'
  baseline leaves them scattered around zero, and flooring would discard
  that signal before baseline correction.

## Value

A `chrom_list` with blank-subtracted samples. Blanks themselves are
removed from the returned list, and so is any `"estimated_baseline"`
attribute on the samples.

## Details

Blanks recorded on a different time grid from a sample (for example, one
or two points longer or shorter) are linearly interpolated onto the
sample's retention times before subtraction. Where the sample runs past
either end of the blank, the blank's first or last value is carried
forward, with a warning if this spans more than 5 time points. Blanks
and samples must share the same wavelengths.

## See also

[`preprocess`](https://ethanbass.github.io/chromatographR/reference/preprocess.md),
[`correct_baseline`](https://ethanbass.github.io/chromatographR/reference/correct_baseline.md)

Other preprocessing functions:
[`correct_baseline()`](https://ethanbass.github.io/chromatographR/reference/correct_baseline.md),
[`crop_chroms()`](https://ethanbass.github.io/chromatographR/reference/crop_chroms.md),
[`preprocess()`](https://ethanbass.github.io/chromatographR/reference/preprocess.md)

## Examples

``` r
data(Sa_warp)
subtract_blanks(Sa_warp, blank_id = 1)
```
